assessment_summary:
- Construction (0001-0016): Valid definition of the function h on the residual network based on the difference between flows g and f.
- (i) Capacity constraints (0017-0025): Valid verification that h respects both forward and backward residual capacities.
- (ii) Flow conservation (0026-0113): Valid proof of conservation at intermediate nodes by carefully rearranging the difference of conservation equations for g and f into sums over residual arcs.
- (iii) Flow value (0114-0160): Valid computation of the net flow out of s in Gf as |g| - |f|, relying on the standard assumption of no original edges entering the source.
- Conclusion (0161-0162): Valid deduction that h is a feasible flow of the required value.
